text_en: Set the trumpet to your lips! One like a vulture is over the house of the Lord , because they have broken my covenant, and transgressed my law.
text_cn: 你要把号角放在你的口上，当作上主家的哨兵，因为百姓违背了我的盟约，干犯了我的法律。

text_en: Israel cries to me, “My God, we—Israel—know you! ”
text_cn: 他们呼喊我说：以色列的天主！我们认识你。

text_en: Israel has spurned the good; the enemy shall pursue him.
text_cn: 但以色列抛弃了善，所以敌人要迫害她。

text_en: They made kings, but not through me; they set up princes, but without my knowledge. With their silver and gold they made idols for their own destruction.
text_cn: 他们自立了君王，却没有我的同意；他们自立了首领，却没有叫我知道；他们用金银为自己制造了偶像，给自己招来灭亡。

text_en: Your calf is rejected, O Samaria. My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
text_cn: 撒玛黎雅！我必要除掉你的牛犊，我的怒火必要对它燃起；以色列子民不能自新要到几时呢？

text_en: For it is from Israel, an artisan made it; it is not God. The calf of Samaria shall be broken to pieces.
text_cn: 牛犊是工匠制造的，它并不是天主；撒玛黎雅的牛犊必定被粉碎！

text_en: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind. The standing grain has no heads, it shall yield no meal; if it were to yield, foreigners would devour it.
text_cn: 他们既播种了风，收的也必是风；麦子不抽穗，做不成面粉；即便做出面粉来，也必被外邦人吃掉。

text_en: Israel is swallowed up; now they are among the nations as a useless vessel.
text_cn: 以色列被吞没了，今后在列邦中必成为一个无用的废物。

text_en: For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild ass wandering alone; Ephraim has bargained for lovers.
text_cn: 他们去投奔亚述──一匹孤独的野驴──同时又给埃及送爱情的礼物。

text_en: Though they bargain with the nations, I will now gather them up. They shall soon writhe under the burden of kings and princes.
text_cn: 纵然他们在列邦中行贿，我现在就要分散他们，使他们暂时停止给君王和首领傅油。

text_en: When Ephraim multiplied altars to expiate sin, they became to him altars for sinning.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因建筑了许多祭坛，但这些祭坛为他们却只有犯罪的用途。

text_en: Though I write for him the multitude of my instructions, they are regarded as a strange thing.
text_cn: 虽然我为他们写了许多法律，却被看作陌生人的废话。

text_en: Though they offer choice sacrifices, though they eat flesh, the Lord does not accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins; they shall return to Egypt.
text_cn: 让他们奉献燔祭，让他们取吃祭肉：这一切上主都不喜欢；今后他必记住他们的邪恶，必惩罚他们的罪孽；他们必要回到埃及去。

text_en: Israel has forgotten his Maker, and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour his strongholds.
text_cn: 以色列忘了自己的造主，建立了许多宫殿，犹大也增建了许多坚固的城池；但是，我必要把火投在他们的城中，吞灭城中的宫室。
